notes.title: Online stability improved, voice chat added
notes.content:
[list]
[*]UDP enabled for performance reasons and lower latency

[*]Connection and disconnection handling improved:
   champions get killed if player disconnects too long or closes the connection.
   you can just load the game when hosting a room and continue later on.

[*]Voice chat was added, at the moment turned on by default per game,
    settings for it will be added with a future update
[/list]

notes.title: Online modes enabled plus small Improvements
notes.content:
Close to the Steam Next Fest, you have the opportunity to test the online modes in advance.

I also added a Form for Feedback which is collected in a private Discord channel.

There are also minor UI Improvements and sounds for the cards were added.

I will also regularly check and try to play with anyone who is around during the next time.

[u][b]Please be aware that currently you need to open the settings Menu with the cog wheel and select a higher graphics quality setting because by default it could be set to the lowest tier.

Sorry![/b][/u]

The game also works on the Steam Deck on ultra, but no verification yet and no button controls, just with touch or virtual mouse input.

I plan to add voice chat next, to make communication independent of discord etc..
